text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. At its core, it involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what an object is, and object detection, which locates where that object is in a scene. For example, a system can recognize a cat in a photo and then draw a box around it to show its position. This technology has many practical applications, from unlocking your phone with your face to sorting photos in your gallery. One of the most exciting uses is in self-driving cars. These vehicles rely on computer vision to detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars, helping them make safe decisions in real time. As the technology improves, we can expect even smarter machines that interact more naturally with our world.
